ops.title: Remove automatic historical replay from long-running upgrades
ops.description: Owner:/root. User explicitly stopped load-generating historical replay and requested that it never run automatically. Remove installer GateFault and supervisor Upgrade.Stale replay execution, keep ordinary release/config checks and explicit manual replay commands. No local replay, load tests, stress fixtures or benchmarks. PR2477 contains23insertions/143deletions with regression assertions that version checks launch no subprocesses and install preflight only runs bounded target validation. Required next step: publish official binary, install/unquarantine plugin and activate new code without invoking an old installer or automatic historical replay. Existing supervisor57425 and every agent/terminal/session remain protected. Original IO repair remains task f7b782addf3f8b22d1a1331d885dfbc1ee23f3b6; all Go orca tests passed follow-upCI41735532461, with one separate supervisor lifecycle timeout still open.

ops.text: Installer and supervisor automatic upgrade paths have no historical replay invocation; targeted regression checks pass in CI
